scope_note: Names and definitions identify the programme and development scope. They do not establish a completed game, validated model, biological or clinical capability.
release_policy: Existing experimental previews may be published with their actual version, source and limitations. Production-grade acceptance is not a prerequisite for preview upload; privacy, redistribution rights, security and truthful scientific scope remain required. Paper content pointers distinguish selected compiled PDFs from preserved historical source snapshots; content identity does not establish remote publication verification. Git history and original local evidence remain.
license_note: Project-owned contributions CC0-1.0; third-party materials retain their own rights and notices.
development_status: active; work has resumed alongside NeuroSurge and Interoceptomics
programme_focus: NeuroTranslation, NeuroSurge and Interoceptomics are active together.

data_companion.meaning: Import and inspect recordings locally. Replay the R1 cohort fit, or compare the fixed and personally calibrated models on an imported R2 trial. Full R2 trials are checked against their archived sample clock and four selected input streams. Aggregate evidence is shown separately.
data_companion.hosting: Prepared static main/docs payload; actual Pages deployment/readback is verified separately

navigation_overlay.scope: Navigation update. The cached runtime asset names, bytes and buildId retain their previous identity.

papers.scope: Four rebuilt technical and accessible drafts compare wrist angle, measured grip force and released index-sensor voltage. The new Hyser comparison covers two days and four development participants distinct from its training cohort.
papers.build_provenance: Four PDFs rebuilt through the retained offline Tectonic toolchain.
papers.source_status: 77 cleared TeX/BibTeX files. The manifest identifies omitted build dependencies.
papers.publication_scope: This metadata identifies selected content; actual publication and remote readback require a separate receipt.

latest_experimental_candidate.scope: Four rebuilt technical and accessible drafts compare wrist angle, measured grip force and released index-sensor voltage. The new Hyser comparison covers two days and four development participants distinct from its training cohort.

selected_manuscript_source.scope: 77 cleared TeX/BibTeX files. The manifest identifies omitted build dependencies.

historical_scientific_layout.scope: Four experimental working drafts, 546 pages; recorded targeted visual evidence covers 26 pages, with 520 outside visual acceptance; no whole-paper or biological acceptance.
historical_scientific_layout.build_provenance: R2 technical PDFs retained; accessible editions have actual R3 builds. The R3 Brain2Body Simple English PDF equals its preceding R2 bytes.

download_bundle.scope: Four exact selected PDFs, three companions, README, content manifest and five notice files. No standalone font, source, model or private evidence files. Native extraction/PDF-link behavior across operating systems remains unverified.

historical_scientific_layout.source_status: Preserved R9/R11 sources are historical, not matching build-source bundles for the current PDFs. R11 remains unbuilt/nonstandalone, with its G35 proposal unadopted.

portable_interface.status: Source only; no model payload, download, runtime or finished GUI claim

wrist_pointing.source_rights: CC BY 4.0, attribution included in each benchmark.
wrist_pointing.cohort_scope: Six training, three development participants; 1,879 eligible training trials and 960 eligible development trials, with six reserved participants.
wrist_pointing.scope_note: The interactive controls change explicitly invented features. Reported errors describe separate, frozen analyses of the measured pointing task at a nominal 250 ms forecast horizon; physical latency is unmeasured.

wrist_pointing_forecasts.comparison_scope: Six training participants with 1,879 eligible recorded trials; three different development participants supplied 960 complete trials. 250 ms forecast horizon on the archive clock. The reserved test recordings remain unopened.

recorded_trial_replay.verification_scope: Fingerprints cover all six input windows, measured two-axis targets, archive and clock metadata for all 960 original development trials. Six trained temporal checkpoints execute in the browser. Cohort errors and individual recorded trials have separate views. The 250 ms lead refers to stored rows; device delays are unverified.
recorded_trial_replay.public_contents: Public artifact contains aggregate scores, fitted models, code and checksums; the reader supplies a trial locally.
recorded_trial_replay.limits: Verified on Linux Chromium with hosted, offline and emulated narrow-screen cases. No TEST records included or examined.

wrist_forearm_transfer.scope: Six training participants, three previously evaluated development participants, six reserved test participants not examined.

uji_forearm_emg.scope: Offline healthy-volunteer daily activities. Participant-specific reference posture, retrospectively filtered wrist-angle targets. Observations from the four final test volunteers were not evaluated.

daily_wrist_browser.scope: Estimates of retrospectively filtered glove angles in offline daily-activity trials. The interface runs two fixed estimators and a weighted combination on invented or compatible local inputs. The weights were selected within training. The four development participants had been studied before, and final test participants remain reserved.

way_grip_force.scope: Offline voluntary pinch-lift force forecasting. Aligned scalp EEG slightly reduced equal-person development RMSE versus mechanical history. The phase-matched EEG model did better than aligned EEG.

browser.input_scope: Original single windows, invented trial replay, and compatible locally converted WAY-EEG-GAL WS trials. Four displayed predictors use preceding sensor samples. Twenty-nine separately stored later grip forces can be revealed to score each forecast. The browser ZIP contains no participant samples.

way_contact_force.scope: Two offline grip-force forecasts compared after the tenth consecutive sample at or above 0.5 N on the 500 Hz recording clock. Adding aligned scalp EEG increased average error in both families on the same explored development cohort. Final test reserved. The launchers use invented input by default.

browser.scope: Frozen ridge and causal CNN weights run on the same prior window. An invented example or compatible local JSON supplies inputs. A future target sample can be shown only when supplied. Rotation is an aggregate control. The 120 ms horizon is on the recording clock.

browser.trial_replay: One right-hand trial per local file; 205 scheduled cutoffs, conditional on complete input and target support. The example is invented.
browser.signal_plot: Twenty 50 Hz transducer readings and a selectable forecast at +120 ms. Trial outcomes are shown only when revealed.

hygrip_force.scope: First scoring of three original HYGRIP development participants after public protocol posting. The browser uses fixed TRAIN fits and invented example inputs by default. FINAL remains reserved.

secondary_emg.tested_endpoint: forecast of released sensor voltage 120 ms after issue
secondary_emg.scope: Secondary right-hand analysis on the same three previously studied development people. Timing-specific forearm EMG and scalp EEG directional screens failed on TRAIN and DEV.

study.scope: Index-finger sensor voltage on a distinct two-day isometric task. Physical real-time lead remains unverified.
study.decision: No average primary incremental gain from aligned EMG in this experiment; held-participant and day-specific results reported.

hyser_index.scope: Released index transducer voltage 120 ms ahead on the nominal stream. Four final participants reserved. No online or clinical claim.

hygrip_force.status: Protocol and source coverage after TRAIN work began and before DEV or FINAL access.
hygrip_force.scope: Cued right-hand power grip in a separate dataset. Target is a transducer-voltage reading 120 ms ahead on the released clock.

hygrip_cue_phase.scope: Comparison of cue-conditioned and shared voltage dynamics on the previously studied healthy HYGRIP cohort.
hygrip_cue_phase.outcome: The phase-conditioned residual did not beat the original full-history benchmark on either split. Previously studied development cohort. The full-history ridge remains selected.

hyser_index.scope: Index-finger sensor voltage on a distinct two-day isometric task. Physical real-time lead remains unverified.
hyser_index.decision: No average primary incremental gain from aligned EMG in this experiment; held-participant and day-specific results reported.
